title: Transient Myc–Cyclin T1 modRNA after experimental myocardial infarction
model: Adult CD1 mouse LAD-ligation MI; 100 micrograms M-C modRNA injected intramyocardially at surgery. This assessment concerns the modRNA intervention, not the separate transgenic MycER(T2)+AAV-Ccnt1 experiments.
source_reported_interpretation: The authors interpret proliferation, cardiomyocyte-number, CycleTrack and functional findings as evidence of cardiac regeneration. CardiEval's stricter classification is mixed_evidence because functional maturation of newly generated cardiomyocytes and formal electrophysiological safety were not established.

domains.assay: EdU pulse at 8 h and 24 h; cardiomyocyte DNA synthesis; Ki67/BrdU in vitro
domains.model: Adult CD1 mouse LAD-ligation MI; M-C modRNA
domains.timepoint: EdU at 8 h and 24 h; Myc/Cyclin T1 protein not detected at 24 h
domains.effect_estimate: M-C significantly increased cardiomyocyte EdU positivity versus FLuc; exact numerator/denominator not transcribed
domains.uncertainty: Source-data workbook should be curated before quantitative pooling
domains.notes: Direct cell-cycle entry evidence; not alone proof of completed cytokinesis.

domains.assay: pHH3 and CycleTrack G2/M genetic tracing; adjacent labelled cardiomyocyte doubles
domains.model: Adult mouse MI model with M-C modRNA
domains.timepoint: pHH3 after EdU pulse; CycleTrack hearts collected 2 weeks after MI
domains.effect_estimate: CycleTrack-labelled cardiomyocyte doubles: 41.5% after M-C versus 5.5% after GFP
domains.uncertainty: Doubles are a proxy in this tracing strategy; detailed cell-level denominators and animal-level variance need source-data curation
domains.notes: Supports division; does not establish mature functional integration.

domains.assay: Total heart cardiomyocyte number at day 5; CycleTrack genetic tracing
domains.model: Adult mouse MI model with M-C modRNA
domains.timepoint: Day 5 for total cardiomyocyte number; 2 weeks for CycleTrack tracing
domains.effect_estimate: Increased total heart cardiomyocyte number reported at day 5; CycleTrack-labelled doubles 41.5% versus 5.5% control
domains.uncertainty: Precise animal-level denominators and confidence intervals require source-data extraction
domains.notes: Stronger than cell-cycle markers alone; independent replication and integration characterization remain needed.

domains.model: Adult mouse MI model with M-C modRNA
domains.notes: No direct demonstration of sarcomeric, calcium-handling, electrophysiological and contractile maturation of daughter cardiomyocytes.

domains.assay: Serial echocardiography; LVEF and left-ventricular muscle area
domains.model: Adult CD1 mouse LAD-ligation MI, 100 micrograms M-C modRNA
domains.effect_estimate: At 12 weeks, delta LVEF: -7.1% +/- 6.7% M-C (n=15) versus -16.1% +/- 6.1% FLuc (n=12); reported one-tailed p=0.0006
domains.uncertainty: Small cohorts; one-tailed test; prespecification and multiplicity context need source-data/reporting review
domains.notes: Functional benefit is separate from proof of regeneration.

domains.model: Adult CD1 mouse LAD-ligation MI, M-C modRNA
domains.effect_estimate: No change in scar size reported at day 28 in the M-C modRNA cohort
domains.uncertainty: Exact estimate and uncertainty should be extracted from source-data workbook
domains.notes: Do not substitute increased LV muscle area for demonstrated scar reduction.

domains.model: Adult mouse M-C modRNA MI model
domains.notes: Formal electrophysiology and mapping in large animals are explicitly identified by the authors as future work.

domains.assay: Organ histology and Ki67 survey; survival follow-up; separate sustained-expression genetic model
domains.model: M-C modRNA mice to 12 weeks; separate global MycER(T2)+AAV-Ccnt1 model is a distinct exposure
domains.timepoint: 12 weeks for M-C histology; 3–7 days for distinct sustained/global-expression hazard
domains.effect_estimate: No tumors observed in surveyed organs at 12 weeks; survival difference not significant (log-rank p=0.2008). In separate global genetic model, 7/8 mice became moribund or died after sustained/global MycER(T2)+Cyclin T1 activation.
domains.uncertainty: Different exposure modalities and cohorts; global-model lethality is a hazard signal, not an M-C modRNA event rate
domains.follow_up: 12 weeks for M-C; 3–7 days for separate sustained-expression model
domains.notes: Keep favorable 12-week histology and severe separate-model expression hazard distinct; 12 weeks is not lifetime surveillance.
